/* El catálogo LOCAL con los datos REALES de producción: se sirven los archivos
 * del worktree y se deja que hablen con el Supabase productivo. Sólo lectura. */
import { chromium } from '@playwright/test';
const BASE='http://127.0.0.1:4599'; const OUT='artifacts/weekend-launch';
const CONFIG = `globalThis.__LA_TABA_RUNTIME_CONFIG__ = {
  mode: 'production',
  repository: { provider: 'supabase', deploymentEnvironment: 'production',
    supabaseUrl: 'https://wwcpogltfgzgkrlilbcd.supabase.co',
[EXCLUIDO: credencial/configuración; recrear localmente.]
    businessId: '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', pollMs: 5000 } };`;
const nav=await chromium.launch();
const ctx=await nav.newContext({viewport:{width:390,height:844},hasTouch:true,isMobile:true,deviceScaleFactor:2,locale:'es-AR'});
await ctx.route('http://127.0.0.1:4599/runtime-config.js', (r)=>r.fulfill({status:200,contentType:'application/javascript',body:CONFIG}));
const page=await ctx.newPage();
const errores=[]; page.on('pageerror',e=>errores.push(e.message)); page.on('console',m=>{if(m.type()==='error')errores.push(m.text().slice(0,160));});
await page.goto(`${BASE}/#catalog`,{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded'});
try { await page.locator('html[data-taba-startup="ready"]').waitFor({state:'attached',timeout:25_000}); }
catch (e) { console.log('NO ARRANCO. estado=', await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.dataset.tabaStartup||'(sin atributo)'));
  console.log('texto:', (await page.evaluate(()=>document.body.innerText)).slice(0,600));
  console.log('errores:', JSON.stringify([...new Set(errores)].slice(0,10), null, 1)); await nav.close(); process.exit(0); }
await page.waitForTimeout(4000);
const info = await page.evaluate(()=>({
  tarjetas: document.querySelectorAll('.product-card').length,
  condiciones: [...document.querySelectorAll('.price-condition')].map(e=>{
    const card=e.closest('article'); return `${(card?.querySelector('h3')?.textContent||'').trim()} · ${(card?.querySelector('p')?.textContent||'').trim()} → «${e.textContent.trim()}»`;}),
}));
console.log(`tarjetas: ${info.tarjetas}`);
console.log('RENGLONES BAJO EL PRECIO:'); info.condiciones.forEach(c=>console.log('  '+c));
// abrir la ficha de un pack
const pack = page.locator('.product-card:has-text("Pack x12")').first();
if (await pack.count()) {
  await pack.locator('[data-product-detail]').first().click();
  await page.waitForTimeout(1800);
  console.log('\nFICHA DEL PACK:', JSON.stringify(await page.evaluate(()=>{
    const m=document.querySelector('.modal-price'); const c=document.querySelector('.modal-product-copy');
    return { presentacion:(c?.querySelector('.modal-presentation')?.textContent||'').trim(),
      titulo:(c?.querySelector('h2')?.textContent||'').trim(), precio:(m?.textContent||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim() };})));
  await page.screenshot({ path:`${OUT}/local-ficha-pack.png` });
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape'); await page.waitForTimeout(800);
}
await page.screenshot({ path:`${OUT}/local-catalogo-produccion.png`, fullPage:false });
console.log('\nERRORES: '+JSON.stringify([...new Set(errores)].slice(0,6)));
await nav.close();
